tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Find datasets from NSI and Eurostat (population, income, poverty, prices, employment, GDP, climate …) by words of their Bulgarian title. Without a query, lists all of them.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Title, period, source and the dimensions of a dataset with their codes and labels, needed for get_dataset_data filters.

tools.name: get_dataset_data
tools.description: Values of a dataset, filtered by dimension codes (from get_dataset) and period. At most 2000 rows.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Bulgaria, its 6 NUTS2 regions and 28 oblasts with their slugs.

tools.name: get_region_wages
tools.description: Average gross monthly wage by year (2008–) for Bulgaria, a NUTS2 region or an oblast, in euro and leva, with the number of employees.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: The economic activities (NACE sections, КИД-2008) with their slugs.

tools.name: get_activity_wages
tools.description: Average gross monthly wage by year for an economic activity; also public/private sector or men/women.

tools.name: get_occupation_wages
tools.description: Gross, median and net monthly wage by occupation class from the NSI Structure of Earnings survey (every 4 years). Without a year, the latest.

tools.name: get_municipality
tools.description: Population, births and deaths by year for one of the 265 municipalities, by its Bulgarian name (e.g. Първомай, Столична) or EKATTE code, with the link to its page.

tools.name: list_elections
tools.description: Parliamentary (since 1991) and presidential (since 1992) elections: date, voters, turnout.

tools.name: get_election_results
tools.description: Votes and shares of every party or candidate in the country, abroad or by oblast.
